Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed every 5 years as indicated by Y5 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng Medhat Fouad, tested at 05 June 2003, revised by EDEPCo.quality control eng. Abouda Elbana, 
accepted by General Manager eng.Ali Mostafa El_Lithy and 
Approved by eng. Mostafa Alaam Talkha PS Head Sector.
Safety Precautions
Issue work order including the team 
work names
Wear safety helmet shoes- gloves, 
etc.
Use safety fence (Rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the 
pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the 
pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by 
closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely 
drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.
Feeler 
gauge, 
 Dial 
indicator
Vibrometer, 
Straight edge, 
 Rags.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.
Feeler 
gauge, 
 Dial 
indicator
Vibrometer, 
Straight edge, 
 Rags.
Work to be carried out
Disassembly
Checks discharge quantity and 
 pressure and record them.
Check the vibration level of the 
 pump set complete with the motor then, record them.
Measure the pump alignment and 
 record it.
Dismantle the electric motor and 
 take it out.
Dismantle all attached pipes to 
 the pump.
Dismount the half coupling of the 
 pump shaft.
Loosen the follower glands and 
 take out the stuffing box packing cords.
Discharge the oil from the bearing 
 sump
Loosen the bearing caps and remove 
 them from the pedestal.
Unscrew the sleeve nut of the 
 bearing and take it out.
Dismount the thrust bearing 
 (29415) and the two journal bearings (2317K-1317K) of the suction and 
 discharge sides of the pump.
Screw out the nuts fixing the 
 pedestal to the pump casing.
Lift the pump to the work place 
 and put it on its maintenance stand.
Loosen the clamping bolts and 
 remove them from the pump.
Dismantle the impellers of the 
 pump beginning from suction side up to discharge side
Place suitable pad under the 
 loosened shaft.
Dismantle all worn-out sleeves by 
 heating.
If new rotor parts (bushes, 
 impellers) are used, it is necessary to balance the assembled rotor 
 dynamically.
Inspection
The 
 validity of journal bearing white metal castings.
Check the radial clearance of the 
 pump by measuring the clearances between the wearing rings which are installed 
 in the diffusers and the distance sleeves on the shaft.
The validity of the anti-friction 
 bearings.
Check all parts for any worn-out.
Check all parts for cracks.
Inspect the run-out of shafts.
Assembly
Place 
 the suction casing with the bolted bearing pedestal on an assembly stand or on 
 the base plate.
Insert the shaft with mounted gland 
 sleeves for the stuffing box and put it into the bearing pedestal through the 
 stuffing box space of the suction casing and support the shaft from the other 
 side.
Build in the radial bearing.
Fit the first impeller and ensure 
 that the inner front wall of the impeller channel mates with the surface of 
 the diffuser shim.
Fit the other impellers by the same 
 way up to the last stage.
Check the clearance of the rotor in 
 the longitudinal axis (3-5mm).
Mount the thrust bearing so that the 
 rotor is approximately on the center of this clearance.
Rotate the pump rotor and ascertain 
 that it is easy rotating otherwise dismantle the pump and solve the problem of 
 axial clearance.
Insert the stuffing box with new 
 packing cords.
Put the pump in its place and mount 
 all attached pipes.
Put the motor on its place.
Adjust the alignment between motor 
 shaft and pump shaft and record them.
Starting the Pump
Before 
starting the pump, the following steps should be checked: -
Check the oil level in the 
 thrust-bearing pump bath
Open the cooling water for the oil 
 bath of the thrust bearing and gland packing.
Open the suction and delivery valves 
 of the pump.
Check the direction of rotation of 
 the pump by pushing the electric button of the motor pump instantaneously.
Attendance and checking during operation
During 
operation of the pump, the following should be checked
The temperature of the anti-friction 
 bearing (it should be not exceed 75C).
The temperature of cooling water for 
 bearing oil and gland packing.
Any water leakage and oil leakage.
The discharge quantity and pressures 
 (suction and discharge) of the pump and record them.
Check the vibration level and record 
 it.
